text:
sre-bot: ALERT: sudden surge of cross-region fallbacks for tier=enterprise. latency x3, error-rate +2%. routing loop suspected — see /dash/routing/fallbacks
anya: seeing the same on the console. a bunch of tenants showing continuous failover to us-east variants then immediate fallback back to eu-west. looks like variant incompatibility triggering retries.
mohit: logs show repeated HTTP 409-like errors during model init: tokenizer mismatch between variant 'redwood-llm-v1.3' and fallback 'redwood-llm-v1.0'. router retries because the fallback reports "accepted" but then fails when tokenization starts. loop++
jorge: ugh. can we short-circuit: if a fallback returns VARIANT_INCOMPATIBLE, mark tenant-variant pair as quarantined for X seconds and don't try cross-region fallback?
emily: agree. quick mitigation: set enterprise routing policy to disallow cross-region fallback and add exponential backoff on variant errors. patch suggestion: 
```yaml
routing:
  tiers:
    enterprise:
      cross_region_fallback: false
      variant_incompat_quarantine_s: 60
      variant_retry_backoff_ms: 500,1000,2000
```
kai: longer-term we need a circuit-breaker metric in telemetry: increment on VARIANT_INCOMPATIBLE and surface per-tenant. also tag variants with tokenizer/version hash so router can detect incompat before routing.
mohit: hotpatch plan: 1) push config toggle (emily) 2) add short-circuit in router: if last response for tenant had VARIANT_INCOMPATIBLE within 60s, return 503 with reason and don't fallback 3) deploy hotpatch to routing-prod.
emily: opened quick PR with config change and router guard, link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing/pull/842 — small change, mostly config + one guard.
jorge: okay deploy then. @deploy-bot run pipeline routing-prod/hotfix-842
deploy-bot: Deploy started for routing-prod/hotfix-842 by emily.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: routing-prod/hotfix-842 — 1748606190
mohit: after the patch, we're seeing >90% reduction in cross-region retries for the affected tenants. still a few edge cases for low-volume tenants where cached metadata is stale.
anya: nice. can we also add a short-lived dashboard tile: "variant_incompat events" and alert when >5 in 5m per tenant?
kai: yes, I'll add the telemetry panel and a pager rule that only pages if enterprise tier + sustained.
emily: I'll follow up with a PR to tag incompatible variants in model-catalog (add tokenizer_hash field) and a migration to populate current models.
jorge: create a small runbook entry? something Ops can follow if this recurs. simple steps: disable cross-region fallback for tenant, increase quarantine window, roll back new model if needed.
anya: thanks everyone. recording postmortem notes in #postmortems after we stabilize. :white_check_mark:
mohit: reassigning follow-ups: emily=deploy config PR, kai=telemetry panel + pager, emily+mgmt=update model catalog tags. I'll keep monitoring for 2h.
anya: metrics look stable now. closing alert. :lock_with_ink_pen:
